Notes: Live text from Randy's ICC Shuttleport scrape 2026-10-30 (dialogs_raw 4582, 14:28-16:07 ET). ICC Bio-Inspector (835x755). Cull (DBC*) and leader survey (DBT*, 4 leaders here; live has 5 starting with the snake leader). Generated by ddogs/tools/Build-Live4582.py.

thorn.Text: Brandon Thorn said I should talk to you.

find_stacklund.Text: Do you know where to find Antonio Stacklund?

ask_cull.Text: Sure, I'll help. What do you need?

ask_tag.Text: Anything else I can help with?

Text: {emote}The male nanomage looks up from the papers he's reading when you approach and nods. He looks serious but friendly.{/emote}
\nHello there. I saw you step off the crashed shuttle. I guess I should say 'Welcome to Rubi-Ka', huh?

thorn.Text: Good chap, that Thorn. I could use some help here to be honest. Could help clear up your head as well. Or, if you don't have time, maybe I could give some directions?

Text: Just run through the tunnel behind me. At the end, you'll come to a ramp leading up to the main compound.
{delay 1} Go past the soldiers and you'll soon find him.
{delay 2}\nIf you decide to stay here, though, let me know. I can always use an extra pair of hands.
Great! I could use the help. Ever since the aliens started attacking Rubi-Ka, we've had regular shuttle crashes, and supplies run short all the time.
{delay 2}I have cataloged the species here, both flora and fauna, and know which ones have beneficial properties.
{delay 2} I'm also in charge of the wildlife cull.

cull.Text: Do you have any idea how fast the animals here on Rubi-Ka breed? If we don't keep the numbers down, they will overrun the island. I need someone to handle a few too many creatures further west on the beach.

give_cull.Text: {givequest DBC0} Great. I'll upload the details to your system. Just head further west and clear out the amount you're asked to. Return to me when you're done, I'll pay you for the job.

busy_cull.Text: Just head further west and clear out the amount you're asked to. Return to me when you're done, I'll pay you for the job.

after_cull.Text: Good job! The eco system here is a fragile thing, and we have to make sure it doesn't go completely wild. Balance is imperative.

Text: Hm...actually, yes, there is. Each of the animal species here on the beach has a leader. Alpha male or female. I need to note down their location, as the herds and packs move around with them.
{delay 2}{givequest DBT0}I'd like you to find out where they all are. I'll upload the details to you. Come back when you're done, I'll make sure to compensate you.

busy_tag.Text: I'd like you to find out where they all are. Come back when you're done, I'll make sure to compensate you.

Text: You could always check with Adri if he's got something for you. He's one of the people who have chosen to stay here at the shuttle port, despite the alien attacks. He's not ICC employed, but he does the odd jobs for Stacklund and Molen.

{delay 2}\n\nI saw him at the docks earlier, studying the faulty cargo droids and waste collectors. You'll probably find him there. Just continue through the tunnel and head left when you come out. Good luck, kiddo.
